title: Kunoichi Torimonochou
overview:
Multiple endings mean you can play again and again!

Danger lies everywhere before rookie kunoichi "Sagojo Ran" - and temptation too!? What fate awaits "Ran"?

Kunoichi Torimonochou is a training adventure in which you raise Ran, a young female ninja, as she meets a colorful cast of allies and rivals. Your choices steer her through branching scenarios toward one of several endings.

- Fights play out as card battles
- Multiple scenarios and multiple endings
- A wide variety of mini-games
- 20 minutes of newly drawn animated movies
- Voiced by a cast including Yuka Imai, Kotono Mitsuishi and Satomi Korogi

マルチエンディングだから何度でも遊べる!

新米くのいち「沙悟浄 蘭」の前には危険がいっぱい、誘惑もいっぱい!?果たして「蘭」の行く末は?
